poseRules.slew: SLEW rotation about local +Y; retain root identity
poseRules.length: For each nested TELESCOPIC_i, position.x = baseline[i] + (boomLength - 10) / 4
poseRules.hook: HOOK.position = [tipX, requestedHeight, 0], height range1.0..4.5; identity rotation and scale
poseRules.ropes: Rope i position=[tipX,hookHeight+0.23,zOffsets[i]], scale=[1,tipY-hookHeight-0.23,1], identity rotation; zOffsets=[0.07,-0.07]
poseRules.hydraulic: A=[0.59,1.02,0]; B=[2.3*cos(a)+0.22*sin(a),1.42+2.3*sin(a)-0.22*cos(a),0]; M=A+0.55*(B-A). LIFT_BARREL spans A..M and LIFT_PISTON spans M..B. Each unit cylinder points local+Y, origin at lower end: position=start, scale.y=length(end-start), quaternion=setFromUnitVectors(+Y,normalize(end-start)).

geometryAssumptions.profileNote: Authored hollow-shell reconstruction. Section lengths, pentagon angles and nonuniform wall thickness from a scaled inner profile are not manufacturer dimensions.
geometryAssumptions.note: Demo kinematic limits preserve visual stage overlap and rope clearance; these are not certified manufacturer operating limits or load-chart guidance.
